annotation.bound_parties_text: The guidance applies to organisations and individuals operating small unmanned aircraft (aerial work operators, recreational flyers, and pilots/operators of SUA and SUSA).
annotation.bound_parties_quote: An organisation or individual offering services involving the use of a SUA (of any weight) in exchange for financial reward or commercial advantage (otherwise known as Aerial Work) must be in possession of a current Permission
annotation.dates_quote: In addition and with effect from 1st February 2016 SUA are prohibited from flying within 3 nautical miles (nm) of the perimeter of:
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Small Unmanned Aircraft (SUA) is the generic term used in the aviation legislation covering a variety of similar names including, but not limited to, drones
